nodes.label: Intake
nodes.title: The Quest Begins
nodes.summary: A request has arrived at the village gate. Before you set out, learn who has called for help and what trouble they are facing.
questions: Who requested this and who owns the outcome?
What business result are they trying to change?
Is this truly a learning problem, or is it process, tooling, messaging, or performance management?
nodes.output: A short intake note that defines the request, owner, audience, and suspected problem.

nodes.label: TNA
nodes.title: The Hall of Records
nodes.summary: Climb to the great library and read the signs. Find the real gap between what is and what should be before drawing a single sword.
questions: What do people need to do differently after this?
What evidence shows there is a gap?
What do top performers already do that others do not?
What constraints exist: time, tools, policy, market, manager behaviour?
nodes.output: A TNA summary with current state, desired state, root cause, and recommended intervention.

nodes.label: Triage
nodes.title: The Council Chamber
nodes.summary: The council awaits a verdict. Speak plainly: should this quest proceed, pause, change shape, or be passed to another guild?
questions: Does this align to team OKRs or business priorities?
Who would be impacted if this is deprioritised?
What is the opportunity cost?
Do we have enough information to proceed?
nodes.output: A decision note with recommendation, rationale, risks, and next action.

nodes.label: Stakeholder
nodes.title: The Tavern Pact
nodes.summary: Sit with the requester and shake on it. Confirm what will be delivered, what will not, the timeline, and who signs off.
questions: What exactly will be delivered?
What will not be delivered?
How long will this take?
Who approves content, messaging, and launch?
nodes.output: A stakeholder agreement or working brief.

nodes.label: Design
nodes.title: The Architect's Workshop
nodes.summary: Sketch the journey on the workshop wall. Outcomes, modality, practice, reinforcement, measurement. Build a blueprint, not a content dump.
questions: What must learners know, do, and say?
What practice will make the behaviour stick?
Should this be live, self-paced, manager-led, peer-led, or blended?
Where does AI support the learner or facilitator?
nodes.output: A learning blueprint with outcomes, structure, activities, and measurement.

nodes.label: Build
nodes.title: The Forge
nodes.summary: Light the forge. Hammer out the assets, the facilitator notes, the activities, the job aids. Make a complete, testable pack.
questions: What assets are needed for launch?
What can be reused or adapted?
What needs legal, brand, product, or leadership review?
What is the minimum viable version?
nodes.output: A complete asset pack ready for testing.

nodes.label: Risk
nodes.title: The Watchtower
nodes.summary: Climb the tower and look out across the road ahead. What could ambush this launch? Misalignment, weak approvals, missing manager support.
questions: What could go wrong?
What message might be misunderstood?
What dependency could block launch?
What support will learners need afterwards?

nodes.label: Pilot
nodes.title: The Training Grounds
nodes.summary: Test the build in friendly territory before the real campaign. Watch for friction, listen for confusion, log every observation.
questions: Who is the safest pilot group?
What feedback do we need?
What would make this fail at scale?
What must change before launch?
nodes.output: A pilot feedback summary with required changes.

nodes.label: Launch
nodes.title: The Campaign Begins
nodes.summary: Sound the horn. Deliver the programme with strong context, real practice, and a visible route to support afterwards.
questions: How will the audience understand why this matters?
What action should they take immediately afterwards?
What manager or stakeholder reinforcement is required?
Where do learners go for support?
nodes.output: A delivered programme with clear follow-up.

nodes.label: Measure
nodes.title: The Throne Room
nodes.summary: Stand before the throne with proof. Did this work? What changed? What should be repeated, stopped, or improved?
questions: Did the programme solve the original problem?
What evidence proves behaviour changed?
What feedback came from learners, managers, and stakeholders?
What should be repeated, stopped, or improved?
nodes.output: An impact review with evidence, insight, and next steps.
